ordering: Standalone worker owns local Cargo through its completion. Complete affected-package gate follows once, serially. No runtime source amendments during either run. Native CI executes the same committed source remotely.
host_timing_probes: Run the two existing ignored host-only probes once after local build/test jobs are complete, retaining raw samples and boundaries. These are not acoustic or lamp measurements.
handoff: Non-draft PR only after exact-head native success and required source/copy results, with any untouched full-gate failure and isolated pass explicitly listed under First's existing #739 exception.
later_integration: Scheduled fetches continue during qualification; retain and review incoming changes without mutating an active test source.
